_readme: Evaluation set for the retrieval pipeline. Each case is a real question a Pakistani
lawyer might ask, plus what retrieval MUST find for the answer to be usable.
area          bucket, for the per-area report
phrasing      'formal'  = the wording the topic dictionary was written for
'natural' = how a person actually talks. These are the ones that
expose dictionary gaps — track them separately.
expectStatute list of substrings; a statute hit matching ANY of them counts
expectTopics  topic ids classifyQueryIntent should detect (optional)
minCaseLaw    minimum judgments retrieval must return
Matching is substring, case-insensitive, so '302' matches 'Section 302'.
Add cases as you find failures. This file is the scoreboard — edit the
